bounded_private_capture_plan.observer_use_rule: Not treated as working until a fresh isolated test proves the import hook, request gating, identity binding and actual input-stage/result correlation. A collector file existing in GitHub does NOT demonstrate successful capture.
privacy_safeguards: Explicit opt-in per fresh request only via unguessable locally supplied nonce and bound request_id/task_id/task_epoch; no global prompt/response recording
Store original exact UTF-8 prompt/response bytes in a local-only ACL-restricted directory outside Git checkout, logs, artifact packages and sync roots; never upload bytes or absolute local paths
Fail closed on inconsistent request identity, target scope, duplicate round or unexpected transcript capture; do not change Planner text, tool decisions or browser submit/retry semantics
Capture failure => NOT_OBSERVED; a hash of a constructed prompt by itself is NOT submitted delivery proof
Do not emit raw prompts, drafts, user identifiers, browser URLs/CDP endpoints or response body to GitHub; publish only allowlisted hashes, byte sizes, event stage IDs and verification booleans
evidence_state_machine: PREPARED_NOT_SUBMITTED: write exact bytes at final transformed input boundary, hash locally
COMPOSER_VERIFIED: the production composer-integrity check succeeded; no send claim
SUBMIT_ATTEMPTED: production submit path invoked; still not delivery proof
USER_TURN_CONFIRMED: production page scope binds a fresh user turn to this request (mandatory)
RESPONSE_CORRELATED: same ask returned fresh model response; retain exact response only in private store
E2E_CAPTURE_PASS: every required stage, matching IDs, digest and request scope present; otherwise NOT_OBSERVED or FAILED
